issue: Water pump coolant leakage
hidden_clue: early pumps had manufacturer-documented improvement history
false_positive: do not assume every coolant loss is the pump
verify: cold pressure test and direct inspection

issue: Loose body earth / primary battery earth
hidden_clue: one earth fault can mimic several module failures
false_positive: stored U-codes can also be historic low-voltage events
verify: battery/charging test plus loaded earth inspection

issue: Battery warning / charging message with gateway communication fault
hidden_clue: JLR directs checking G4D178 earth before deeper diagnosis
false_positive: must still prove actual charging output
verify: charging test, earth check, full scan

issue: Normal compressor exhaust-valve thud
symptoms: light thud from rear after startup or height change
hidden_clue: can be normal pressure-relief operation
false_positive: not normal if paired with sagging, long compressor runtime or warning
verify: confirm height holds and no EAS faults

issue: Hydraulic air lock causing DRS DTCs
hidden_clue: bleed state can mimic component/electrical fault
false_positive: persistent post-bleed faults need normal diagnosis
verify: JLR bleed procedure plus hydraulic self-test

issue: Premature replacement A/C compressor failure after incorrect run-in
hidden_clue: installation/run-in history is diagnostic evidence
false_positive: original compressor failures have other causes
verify: review repair procedure and oil/refrigerant history

issue: Supercharger torsional isolator backlash/noise
hidden_clue: can imitate timing-drive noise
false_positive: do not assume isolator if bearing roughness/rotor damage or noise persists with drive isolated
verify: JLR supercharger-drive isolation procedure

issue: Door appears closed but may not be securely latched
hidden_clue: flush-looking door can still be insecure
false_positive: VIN and campaign completion must be verified
verify: VIN recall lookup and latch functional inspection

issue: Load-space/tailgate water ingress
evidence: JLR bulletin index plus owner reports
hidden_clue: not every rear leak is a roof drain
false_positive: normal exterior drainage can be mistaken for internal ingress
verify: sectional water test and seal/drain inspection

issue: Panoramic roof drain blockage/outlet deterioration
hidden_clue: outlet/hose can fail physically, not only clog
false_positive: do not use aggressive compressed air before checking hose integrity
verify: gentle flow test and physical outlet/hose inspection

issue: HVAC condensate drain disconnected/blocked causing hidden wet carpet
hidden_clue: rubber-backed carpet can conceal large water volume
false_positive: roof/cowl leaks can look similar
verify: inspect drain connection and under-carpet moisture

issue: Air leak overworks compressor
hidden_clue: compressor may be victim, not root cause
false_positive: compressor output can independently degrade
verify: park-height trend + leak/pressure test + compressor output

issue: Tyre circumference mismatch contributes to driveline/transfer-case stress or shudder
hidden_clue: tyres are part of driveline diagnosis
false_positive: not all transfer-case faults are tyre-induced
verify: compare sizes, pressures, tread depths and rolling circumference

issue: EPB actuator/module wiring or internal water/corrosion failure
hidden_clue: connector corrosion can identify water involvement
false_positive: mechanical brake/caliper/wiring faults can create same message
verify: scan plus actuator command/mechanical and connector inspection

issue: Front lower control-arm bush wear
hidden_clue: bush wear may be found before owner notices noise
false_positive: wheel/tyre imbalance can mimic vibration
verify: loaded-bush/play inspection and alignment assessment

issue: Front-seat wiring/connector fault causing SRS warning
evidence: specialist workshop reports of Land Rover overlay repair
hidden_clue: small-gauge under-seat wiring can be root cause rather than airbag unit
false_positive: SRS diagnosis requires code-specific testing
verify: professional SRS scan and wiring inspection

issue: Intermittent low-coolant warning from near-minimum level or level-sensing fault
symptoms: low coolant warning appears then clears
hidden_clue: vehicle motion/thermal level movement can cross sensor threshold
false_positive: real leak must be excluded first
verify: repeat cold-level measurements + pressure test if level falls

issue: Age-related plastic coolant crossover/bleed pipe leakage
symptoms: residue in engine valley/under supercharger areas
hidden_clue: hot leak may evaporate without driveway puddle
false_positive: exact pipe architecture depends on engine
verify: engine-specific pressure test and visual inspection

issue: Water ingress causing connector/module corrosion and cascading network faults
hidden_clue: surface carpet may appear dry while underlay is saturated
false_positive: low voltage alone can create similar U-code clusters
verify: under-carpet/load-space inspection + connector corrosion + current draw

issue: Brake vacuum hose chafe causing reduced servo assistance
hidden_clue: routing/chafe rather than booster itself
false_positive: do not assume applicability without VIN recall check
verify: VIN recall lookup + professional hose inspection

issue: Cooling fan module internal short / fire risk
hidden_clue: electrical fire mechanism, not merely fan motor wear
false_positive: market/VIN applicability varies
verify: VIN recall lookup

issue: Crankshaft/main-bearing failure
hidden_clue: JLR documented incorrect main-bearing-shell location or shell rotation as causes in a low incidence of failures
false_positive: ordinary diesel combustion noise or accessory noise must not be labelled crank failure without mechanical evidence
verify: stop engine; oil-pressure/mechanical inspection and specialist diagnosis

issue: Throttle body contamination/failure contributes to Restricted Performance and blocked regeneration
hidden_clue: air-control fault can become a DPF problem if regeneration cannot complete
false_positive: DPF restriction, EGR, boost leaks and sensors can produce similar messages
verify: JLR-capable scan, throttle command/position and DPF data

issue: Inlet manifold/rocker-cover air or boost leakage
hidden_clue: load-dependent restricted performance may be an air-path leak rather than turbo failure
false_positive: turbo actuator, sensors and exhaust restriction can mimic it
verify: smoke/pressure test plus requested-vs-actual boost data

issue: EGR/DPF loading from short-cycle use
hidden_clue: operating pattern and failed upstream air-control faults can prevent successful regeneration
false_positive: do not force regeneration before checking oil level, DTCs and safe conditions
verify: soot/load/regeneration history, EGR command/feedback, pressure sensors

issue: MOST optical ring node failure blanks multiple infotainment functions
hidden_clue: one failed node can interrupt the optical ring and make several devices appear dead
false_positive: low voltage, local display power and software can cause similar symptoms
verify: network topology/optical bypass diagnosis plus power/ground checks

issue: Non-transmission faults mimic gearbox failure
hidden_clue: engine torque, mounts, transfer case, tyres, voltage and control inputs can all be felt as a gearbox event
false_positive: do not condemn mechatronics/gearbox from shift feel alone
verify: fluid/temperature/adaptation plus synchronized engine/transmission/driveline data

issue: Fluid condition/level contributes to shift complaints
hidden_clue: level must be checked at specified temperature; generic drain-and-fill assumptions are unsafe
false_positive: fluid service cannot repair established internal mechanical failure
verify: correct temperature-controlled level/condition inspection and adaptation data

issue: Transfer-case clutch/oil/software-related judder
evidence: JLR later SSM supports mechanism on some L405 builds plus specialist pattern
hidden_clue: clutch duty/software and oil condition matter; tyre mismatch should be excluded first
false_positive: 2017-specific JLR SSM must not be applied directly to 2013 without build confirmation
verify: tyre audit, TCCM faults/adaptations/software and fluid assessment

issue: Door-window creak/mechanical interference from contamination
hidden_clue: aggregate-type dust/road film is documented as a cause in bulletin indexing
false_positive: regulator or glass alignment can also cause noise
verify: inspect seals/guides and regulator movement

issue: Powerfold mirror fails to fold or becomes loose
hidden_clue: known service-bulletin category rather than generic motor failure assumption
false_positive: switch/module/low-voltage faults remain possible
verify: scan command and mechanical hinge/motor inspection

issue: Rear roof-opening-panel glass seal loose/adrift
hidden_clue: a seal fault is distinct from a blocked drain
false_positive: water ingress can originate elsewhere
verify: visual seal inspection and controlled water test

issue: Differential pinion oil-seal leakage
hidden_clue: documented service-bulletin topic; distinguish residue from active leak
false_positive: transfer case/transmission leaks can migrate along underbody
verify: clean/trace leak source and check correct fluid level

issue: Temporary tyre flat-spot/imbalance causing steering shimmy
hidden_clue: temporary tyre flat-spot can mimic suspension/wheel-bearing trouble
false_positive: the cited bulletin is broad and not L405-specific in the retrieved revision
verify: road-force/balance/runout and warm-up behavior

issue: Heat-sensitive infotainment or HVAC electronics symptoms
hidden_clue: reproducibility after cabin heat soak helps isolate weak hardware/connection
false_positive: heat is a trigger, not proof of root cause
verify: temperature-correlated reproduction plus power/network checks

issue: High ambient heat accelerates 12V battery degradation and exposes network sensitivity
hidden_clue: battery may start engine yet collapse voltage during wake-up/module loading
false_positive: do not attribute every electrical fault to climate
verify: conductance/capacity test, cranking voltage and charging recovery

issue: Upper-tailgate harness MS-CAN connector terminal retention fault causing broad multi-system failures
hidden_clue: apparently unrelated systems can share one unstable MS-CAN connection near the upper tailgate/headlining
false_positive: do not replace multiple modules because each reports lost communication
verify: full network scan, then workshop continuity/stability test of the documented C44-R2 MS-CAN path while disturbing the harness

issue: Poor continuity at luggage-compartment upper fuse-box holders
hidden_clue: one fuse-holder continuity defect can group rear-body and suspension complaints
false_positive: a visually intact fuse does not prove holder contact quality
verify: workshop continuity/voltage-drop test at the affected rear fuse holders before module replacement

issue: Oversensitive DTCs logged without a corresponding vehicle concern, often after low voltage
symptoms: history of weak battery or low voltage
hidden_clue: JLR published a specific list of codes that can be diagnostic noise in the stated context
false_positive: never ignore a listed code when there is a matching live symptom or repeatable failure
verify: record complete scan and voltage history, correct battery/charging state, clear once appropriate, then see what returns with symptoms

issue: KVM software update can reduce passive-entry/key recognition range
symptoms: key must be very close to handle
hidden_clue: symptom can be introduced by software programming rather than failed antennas or keys
false_positive: physical RF interference, weak key battery and antenna faults still exist
verify: correlate onset with KVM programming history and use owner-handbook keyless-start backup; technician verifies software level

issue: No audio / greyed Audio-Video button from a MOST-bus module software conflict
hidden_clue: one node on the optical ring can disable functions beyond that module
false_positive: do not replace the touchscreen solely because the screen presents the symptom
verify: SDD/network diagnosis; technician isolates the implicated MOST module and confirms fault before replacement

issue: Paired-camera behavior identifies the actually failed camera during blue-screen complaints
symptoms: paired camera flickers three times at switch-on
hidden_clue: rear camera is paired with front-right; right-mirror camera with front-left; the permanently blue camera is the primary suspect
false_positive: do not replace the paired camera merely because it flickers during the documented failure pattern
verify: observe permanent-blue versus three-flicker behavior and then confirm wiring/power before camera replacement

issue: B1412-96 falsely logged in Gateway Module
hidden_clue: JLR explicitly says the false log can refuse to clear due to software
false_positive: do not infer a failed Gateway Module or Quiescent Relay Box solely from this code
verify: confirm code is isolated and symptom-free; follow SSM context rather than replacing hardware

issue: Battery charged with charger earth connected so BMS cannot correctly measure charge current
symptoms: battery charged but vehicle still behaves as undercharged
hidden_clue: charger negative/earth should be connected to the designated chassis/engine earth so current passes through the BMS measurement path
false_positive: this does not fix a genuinely failed battery, alternator or parasitic drain
verify: charge via JLR-specified connection points, then reassess state of charge and repeat fault scan

issue: Incorrectly seated Battery Monitoring System clamp causes low-battery / stop-start complaints
hidden_clue: BMS clamp position on the battery post matters and can make battery logic wrong
false_positive: bulletin does not mean every low-battery warning is a clamp problem
verify: technician checks BMS clamp seating, battery condition, and performs BMS reset when applicable

issue: Poor G3D375 ground causes locking, seat, window, door-state and interior-light anomalies
symptoms: rear doors intermittently do not lock
hidden_clue: multiple body symptoms can converge on one front-seat-crossmember earth point
false_positive: continue normal diagnostics if the earth tests secure and low resistance
verify: loaded continuity/voltage-drop and fastener-security check of G3D375

issue: Touchscreen incorrectly blamed for Bluetooth connectivity faults
hidden_clue: JLR states the front touchscreen module itself has no effect on Bluetooth connectivity
false_positive: a blank screen can coexist with the Bluetooth symptom but does not prove the display is root cause
verify: follow infotainment architecture/network diagnosis rather than replacing FCDIM for Bluetooth alone

issue: Front number plate physically obstructs radar and triggers blocked-sensor fault
hidden_clue: wrong-size or stacked/multiple front plates can obstruct the radar below the plate plinth
false_positive: if plate fitment is correct and unobstructed, continue sensor/alignment/wiring diagnosis
verify: inspect plate size/position and radar field before module replacement or calibration

issue: False bonnet-open message from displaced latch-switch spring
symptoms: bonnet open warning despite bonnet being shut
hidden_clue: latch microswitch actuation can be wrong even when bonnet alignment looks normal
false_positive: do not defeat or bypass the bonnet switch; verify latch condition because it is part of alarm/vehicle logic
verify: inspect latch/switch mechanism and spring positioning using JLR procedure

issue: Intermittent powered tailgate fault needs symptom-led diagnosis rather than actuator guessing
hidden_clue: JLR issued a dedicated diagnostic flowchart because several causes create the same owner symptom
false_positive: low battery or lost tailgate position memory can mimic component failure
verify: record DTCs, restore known battery state/position memory, then follow powered-tailgate diagnostic path

issue: Touchscreen preferences greyed out due to Audio Control Module software
hidden_clue: the root cause can be Audio Control Module software even though the fault is visible on the touchscreen
false_positive: do not replace touchscreen for grey preferences without software/diagnostic verification
verify: technician verifies software level and follows JLR module-configuration procedure with battery support

issue: Missing camera gridlines may simply be a user setting
hidden_clue: JLR warned that technicians were diagnosing a feature that may have been switched off by the user
false_positive: if settings are enabled and lines still fail, diagnose the camera/display system normally
verify: check camera guidance/gridline setting in owner controls before parts or software work

issue: Normal lumbar/massage solenoid exhaust mistaken for pneumatic leak
symptoms: audible air release from massage/lumbar seat
hidden_clue: the solenoid block has a designed exhaust valve that expels air during normal operation
false_positive: loss of support or inability to hold inflation still requires diagnosis
verify: compare operation with JLR seat diagnostics before replacing solenoid block

issue: Deployable side-step ECU replaced when system was not fully activated/configured
hidden_clue: JLR specifically warned of ECU replacement when the accessory had not been fully turned on
false_positive: mechanical obstruction, harness, motor and sensor faults remain possible
verify: confirm accessory activation/configuration and cycle-test before ECU replacement

issue: Blank touchscreen after interrupted/low-voltage software download
hidden_clue: low battery voltage or diagnostic-connection interruption during flashing can corrupt the module
false_positive: do not repeatedly power-cycle or improvise reflashing; recovery is a staged diagnostic process
verify: stabilize battery with approved support and use JLR FCDIM recovery/reconfigure workflow

variants: GEN2.1 L405 affected by USB software download
issue: Touchscreen can remain blank/inoperative after failed USB software download; repeated or wrong recovery attempts can worsen corruption
symptoms: blank touchscreen immediately after software update
hidden_clue: failure chronology matters more than the visual symptom; a display that died during a flash should be treated as software-recovery first
false_positive: do not assume a physically failed LCD/touchscreen before following the documented recovery path
verify: stabilize power, preserve programming history, use current JLR recovery procedure rather than improvised flashing

issue: Cabin-filter access can lead to broken recirculation flap/pivot if the powered flap is forced
symptoms: poor recirculation behavior after cabin-filter service
hidden_clue: the flap is intended to move out of the filter-access path when recirculation is commanded
false_positive: a flap that does not move may have actuator/pivot damage; forcing it can worsen the problem
verify: command recirculation and observe flap/actuator movement before filter removal

issue: Starter motors replaced no-fault-found when battery, relays, harness, B+ or earth were the actual problem
hidden_clue: JLR provided relay-isolation tests specifically because many returned starter motors were not faulty
false_positive: does not apply blindly to 13MY or every starter architecture
verify: battery test, global DTC read, starter relay isolation, B+/T30/T50/earth/fuse/harness checks per current workshop procedure
